parameter: ?1 exact project ID; ?2 SHA256 of the serialized typed DataScope::Project for that ID

anchors.ownedWork: SELECT id FROM work_items WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedAssignments: SELECT id FROM assignments WHERE root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
anchors.ownedSessions: SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedEvents: SELECT id FROM events WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedOperations: SELECT id FROM operations WHERE root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR assignment_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedAssignments) UNION SELECT operation_id FROM events WHERE project_id=?1 AND kind='CommandDecided' AND operation_id IS NOT NULL
anchors.ownedDecisionApprovals: SELECT id FROM decision_approvals WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedConventionImports: SELECT operation_id AS id FROM convention_imports WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedProviderAttempts: SELECT id FROM provider_attempts WHERE session_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSessions)
anchors.ownedUsageAttempts: SELECT attempt_id AS id FROM usage_attempts WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedKnowledgeWrites: SELECT write_id AS id FROM knowledge_writes WHERE scope_key='project:'||?1
anchors.ownedConventions: SELECT DISTINCT convention_id AS id FROM convention_versions WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedConventionIndexes: SELECT generation_id AS id FROM convention_indexes WHERE convention_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedConventions)
anchors.ownedConventionEmbeddingInputs: SELECT request_id AS id FROM convention_embedding_inputs WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedSchedules: SELECT id FROM schedules WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedJobRuns: SELECT id FROM job_runs WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedClaims: SELECT id FROM knowledge_claims WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedEntities: SELECT id FROM knowledge_entities WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedProjectResources: SELECT id FROM resources WHERE scope='project' AND project_id=?1
anchors.ownedGraphPins: SELECT id FROM graph_read_pins WHERE scope_digest=?2
anchors.ownedGraphChildPins: SELECT index_pin_id AS id FROM graph_read_pin_views WHERE pin_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedGraphPins)
anchors.ownedBrowserSessions: SELECT id FROM browser_sessions WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedReceipts: SELECT actor_id,scope_key,idempotency_key FROM command_receipts WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.project_id=?1 AND e.kind='CommandDecided' AND e.aggregate_kind='command' AND e.aggregate_id=COALESCE(json_extract(command_receipts.result_json,'$.receipt.commandId'),json_extract(command_receipts.result_json,'$.purged.commandId')))
anchors.relatedArtifacts: SELECT id FROM artifacts WHERE current_project_id=?1 OR origin_project_id=?1 OR origin_work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR id IN(SELECT artifact_id FROM artifact_shares WHERE project_id=?1) OR id IN(SELECT artifact_id FROM receipt_replies WHERE (actor_id,scope_key,idempotency_key) IN(SELECT * FROM relatedReceipts))
anchors.relatedArtifactVersions: SELECT id FROM artifact_versions WHERE artifact_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifacts)
anchors.relatedSearchChunks: SELECT id FROM search_chunks WHERE source_version_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifactVersions)
anchors.relatedLegacyKnowledge: SELECT id FROM knowledge_entries WHERE project_id=?1 OR id IN(SELECT entry_id FROM knowledge_shares WHERE project_id=?1)
anchors.relatedReceipts: SELECT * FROM ownedReceipts UNION SELECT actor_id,scope_key,idempotency_key FROM command_receipts WHERE command_kind='projects.create' AND json_extract(result_json,'$.receipt.decision.result.value.id')=?1

candidatePredicates.assignments: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.blockers: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR assignment_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedAssignments) OR operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations)
candidatePredicates.job_actions: schedule_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSchedules) OR run_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedJobRuns)
candidatePredicates.job_run_links: run_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedJobRuns) OR root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.knowledge_deliveries: claim_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedClaims) OR session_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSessions)
candidatePredicates.knowledge_history: (target_kind='Claim' AND target_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedClaims)) OR (target_kind='Entity' AND target_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedEntities))
candidatePredicates.queue_entries: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations) OR event_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedEvents)
candidatePredicates.resource_grants: operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations) OR resource_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedProjectResources)
candidatePredicates.session_events: session_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSessions) OR event_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedEvents)
candidatePredicates.stop_coverage: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations)
candidatePredicates.usage_changes: attempt_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedUsageAttempts) OR feature_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.work_dependencies: work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR prerequisite_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.artifact_shares: artifact_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifacts) OR project_id=?1
candidatePredicates.blobs: digest IN(SELECT blob_digest FROM artifact_versions WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifactVersions)) OR digest IN(SELECT extracted_blob_digest FROM extractions WHERE artifact_version_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifactVersions))
candidatePredicates.artifact_blob_pins: blob_digest IN(SELECT blob_digest FROM artifact_versions WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifactVersions)) OR blob_digest IN(SELECT extracted_blob_digest FROM extractions WHERE artifact_version_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedArtifactVersions))
candidatePredicates.knowledge_shares: entry_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedLegacyKnowledge) OR project_id=?1
candidatePredicates.knowledge_links: from_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedLegacyKnowledge) OR to_id IN(SELECT id FROM relatedLegacyKnowledge)
candidatePredicates.knowledge_source_heads: source_ref IN(SELECT source_ref FROM knowledge_claim_basis WHERE claim_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedClaims))
candidatePredicates.authority_grants: json_extract(binding_json,'$.projectId')=?1 OR json_extract(binding_json,'$.rootId') IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.github_issue_intake: project_id=?1 OR work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.integration_links: work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR record_id IN(SELECT id FROM integration_records WHERE project_id=?1)
candidatePredicates.os_notification_deliveries: notification_id IN(SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE project_id=?1)
candidatePredicates.schema_sources: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(body_json,'$.connection.config.projectAccess') AS a WHERE json_extract(a.value,'$.projectId')=?1)

warning: Candidates include independently shared and cross-owner keepers, receipts and their reply lineage; they are not removal selections. Full typed mixed-owner classification, purge-control receipt exemptions, finite keeper closure and current-generation checks remain mandatory before any deletion permit.
